name: Capacitor
summary: A capacitive component or bank identified with its circuit function and ratings.
description: A capacitor representation identifies a capacitive component or arrangement in a circuit. Polarised, non-polarised, adjustable and other variants need the appropriate representation and annotations. In power drawings a capacitor bank is a system assembly, rather than merely a scaled-up generic component mark.

Ratings, discharge arrangements, switching and associated reactors or protection depend on the application and selected equipment. A symbol is an identification aid; it does not provide those design values.
readingNotes: Identify whether the drawing denotes a component or a bank assembly.
Read polarity or adjustable features only where the selected variant documents them.
drawingChecklist: Reference the component or bank rating.
Identify any switching and associated protective equipment.
Link the equipment documentation for discharge or reactor arrangements.
distinction: A capacitor-bank representation does not identify every component of the assembled bank or establish its switching duty.
